text.tspan: WEEKEND SURGE
@unhappychoice drops 499 commits in 48 hrs. Authorities are concerned.
MASS APPROVAL
@unhappychoice approves 59 PRs in one week. Zero rejections. Zero mercy.
SHIPS IT
@unhappychoice releases mdts v0.21.0, taming mermaid's chaotic new defaults
MAJOR BUMP
@unhappychoice yeets faraday-http-cache past a major version. No one blinks.
SELF UPDATE
@unhappychoice upgrades the Anthropic SDK in the tool writing this very report
FIVE ORGS
@unhappychoice touches 20+ repos across 5 GitHub orgs before Sunday ends
LLM WATCHER
@unhappychoice syncs LLM pricing from LiteLLM twice. Keeping tabs on the robots.
NO SURVIVORS
@unhappychoice's dep backlog: obliterated. Ruby, JS, Rust, Java — all patched.
